title: Chapter 321 Diamond Skeleton
content:
Chapter 321 Diamond Skeleton

At this time, hundreds of monsters about 8 meters tall and carrying a basket on their heads walked out from the camp of the undead army. This kind of monster is called a stone-throwing monster. Wang Shuo has seen it before, but it is not so big.

Their attack range is far less than that of the catapult, only six or seven hundred meters away.

But their power is very huge. The huge stones directly hit the light curtain, causing ripples.

Wang Shuo roughly estimated that the total durability of the light curtain of the entire Shanhai City plus the city wall should be several billion.

Only after these durability are consumed can the city wall be truly attacked.

By then, the air defense shield of Shanhai City will also lose its effect, and some flying beasts can attack the soldiers on the city wall.

In the grand war, the power of an individual is small, but countless individuals will eventually form a great force.

Wang Shuo can only let Li Jianguo use the catapult to shoot at those undead monsters.

At this time, some giant beasts made of bones picked up some undead skeletons around them and threw them onto the city wall.

What surprised Wang Shuo was that these skeletons could actually pass through the light curtain.

An undead skeleton was thrown onto the section of the city wall defended by Wang Shuo.

Several generals immediately surrounded it, and Wang Shuo did not hesitate and rushed over.

A closer look revealed that there was something like a drill on the head of the skeleton.

The shape was very strange. It seemed that he should have used this drill to destroy the light curtain and drill in.

[Diamond Drill Skeleton: Can destroy the barrier. ]

After checking it, Wang Shuo got the most critical information about it.

The crowd didn't waste any words. In one round of attack, the undead skeleton was killed on the spot.

Wang Shuo looked up and saw that there were several such skeletons in some places on other sections of the city wall, which made the lords in a hurry, and even killed several archers.

But the attack and defense power of this diamond skeleton are not very high, and it is only for experience.

Just when Wang Shuo didn't take it seriously, something strange happened.

In other places on the city wall, although the diamond skeleton was killed, the death aura he carried infected the surrounding soldiers.

This kind of death aura, unlike ordinary death aura, explodes very quickly, just like poisoning, and it is also contagious.

It seems that this is the real purpose of the undead to throw this kind of skeleton into the light curtain.

Wang Shuo turned around and saw that his Red Flame Army was not affected.

But his allies were not so lucky, and some were infected.

These soldiers affected by the death aura were all soldiers who did not carry the dead soul beads.

I saw that their flesh and blood corroded rapidly at a speed visible to the naked eye. After more than ten breaths, they turned into a new undead skeleton.

Wang Shuo had never seen such a situation before. As far as he knew, the undead were produced by transforming corpses through the altar.

It seems that this method of directly infecting living people must also cost the undead.

Otherwise, it would be impossible for humans to defeat the undead.

Just when there was chaos on the city wall.

A team of priests in long robes quickly rushed up the city wall and ran towards the areas where the undead were infected.

They silently chanted spells, and white light shot out from them, entangled with the black death energy, and finally died together.

"Purification"

Someone heard the last two words in their spell clearly.

Some infected people, as long as their bodies were not corroded too seriously, could be rescued.

In this way, the situation on the city wall was temporarily under control.
